## Why it matters

The SKKG Digital Collection provides online access to a large Swiss holding of artworks and historical objects spanning from prehistory to the present.

For researchers, it offers a single entry point into object-level material across long time periods, useful for tracing collecting practices, material culture, and visual change in Switzerland.
